signal: Humanly raised a $25M Series B (May 2026) and is repositioning to a service-as-a-software model

email.body1:
Tara, saw Humanly closed its $25M Series B and is repositioning toward a service-as-a-software model.

A pivot and a raise at once usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the new motion is fully staffed, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Humanly off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tara, quick follow-up for Humanly.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Humanly needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tara, last bit of proof for Humanly.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Humanly's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tara, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-pivot stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Humanly either way.
